findings.note: Nov 16, 2026 Rotowire note: Terry had an assist in the 6-1 win over Calgary, his first point in three games back from hip surgery. He played both games of the weekend back-to-back, but his ice time is still being managed. He has one assist, a minus-4 rating and three shots so far.

Rotowire notes on this page say Terry skated on the third line and the second power-play unit in practice before his Nov 11 return from hip-labrum surgery. Earlier reports expected a top-six role, and he had 38 assists in 61 games last season.

NHL.com status report: Terry made his season debut Nov 11 after June surgery for a hip impingement and labral tear. Coach Quenneville called him a dependable winger who helps the power play and is used in all situations.
